item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest in public preview. The service previously used only service-managed keys (SMK) by default.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions Durable Task Scheduler are now generally available for Dedicated SKU schedulers. This lets organizations use their own keys to encrypt workflow data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server supports cross-tenant customer-managed keys (CMK)
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now supports cross-tenant customer-managed keys (CMK). Data can be encrypted with keys stored in an Azure Key Vault or Azure Managed HSM in a different Microsoft Entra tenant than the PostgreSQL server.

  • Source: Azure Updates
